post.description: Each event carries a client-generated eventId that acts as an idempotency key per tenant. Re-submitting an event is always safe: duplicates are discarded downstream. The call returns 202 only after the event log (Kafka) has acknowledged every accepted event. Structurally invalid events are reported per item and do not fail the batch.
